# tplink_dhcp_reservations (Data Source)

All static DHCP address assignments configured on the router.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tplink_dhcp_reservations" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `reservations` (Attributes Set) Configured reservations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reservations))

<a id="nestedatt--reservations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reservations`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the reservation is active.
- `hostname` (String) Reservation comment/hostname.
- `ip` (String) Assigned IPv4 address.
- `mac` (String) MAC address (dash-uppercase).
